semantic_schema: Same frozen 9 predicates, deadline evidence, ambiguities and exact-quote verifier for all conditions
thinking: Mandatory; full supported thinking, 16384 output-token cap, 32768 context. Quality and compute reported separately; no hidden reasoning persisted.
sampling: GLM historical temp0; Qwen Direct/Thinking official recommended sampling presets with seed42. This is a supported-configuration comparison, not identical-sampling proof.
aggregation_selection: Validation only; minimum contract-qualified reducer; historical strategies diagnostic. No challenge tuning.
primary_llm_selection: Validation only: prioritise valid schema and mean critical-positive recall (blocking/POA/votability), then semantic assertion agreement and evidence reliability, then latency. Both independent and fallback conditions reported.
routing_validation: 80 complete synthetic records; selected model only after common model comparison. Interpretable gates; minimise calls among candidates within 1 percentage point of always-fallback semantic agreement and no additional positive misses in any critical predicate.
challenge_evaluation: Unchanged57 challenge plus untouched48 complete synthetic benchmark. Old leaky100 test remains historical development evidence and is not reused for model selection or new headline evaluation.
validation_limitations: Supplied old100 validation duplicates historical training
